title: Hamburger with cheese sauce and fried bacon
description: Comfort food with an upgrade: juicy burgers, crispy bacon with a touch of honey, and a creamy cheese sauce that brings everything together. Made with good organic ingredients for great taste in every bite.

instructions.text: Melt the butter and add the flour. Stir to make a roux and let it cook briefly. Gradually add the milk while stirring until you have a smooth sauce. Let it cook for a while.
Remove the sauce from the heat and stir in the grated cheese until it is completely melted. Season with pepper and salt and set aside.
Fry the bacon slices in a pan until crispy. Add the honey at the end and let it cook briefly. Remove from the pan and drain on kitchen paper.
Fry the hamburgers in a pan with some butter until golden brown and cooked through on both sides. Season with pepper and salt.
Halve the buns and spread the cut sides with some butter. Toast them briefly in a pan or grill pan.
Top the bottom halves of the buns with arugula. Place a hamburger on top and spoon over some cheese sauce. Divide the bacon slices over it and optionally finish with a little extra honey and arugula.
